newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London higher, Intel jumps.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London higher, Intel jumps.

text.p: U.S. stocks trading in London advanced on Wednesday with Intel Corp leading the way on the back of higher-than-expected fourth quarter earnings, and dealers said the Dow looked set to open 12-15 points higher. "U.S. shares in London are mostly up," one dealer said. "The Dow should be higher to start with, and after that, who knows?"
Intel was up $5 at $152-1/2, boosted by earnings figures released after Wall Street closed, dealers said.
Fourth quarter profits more than doubled to $1.9 billion, outstripping even the most optimistic estimates. Most shares in the sector were higher in London on the back of the figures.
IBM Corp rose $1/2 to $167-3/8 and Texas Instruments climbed $1/2 to $68. Digital Equipment gained $3/8 to $35-3/8, helped by news of a large order, dealers said.
Among the few shares to lose ground was Abbott Laboratories Inc, down $3/8 at $53 after the failure of a legal challenge to a rival's hypertension drug, dealers said.

March S&P 500 futures trading on Globex were up 1.30 at 774.50 by 1135 GMT while the March long bond future was 3/32 higher at 111-16/32. Dealers said the only U.S. data due was November business inventories at 1500 GMT, with the average forecast a rise of 0.3 percent.
